features.name: Patient Registration and Authentication
features.description: Patients create accounts and securely log in to manage their profile and appointments.
user_stories: As a patient, I can register with my email and phone so that I can book appointments online.
As a patient, I can reset my password so that I can regain access to my account.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new visitor, When they submit valid registration details, Then an account is created and a verification email is sent.
Given a registered patient, When they enter valid credentials, Then they are logged in and see their dashboard.

features.name: Doctor Search and Availability
features.description: Patients search doctors by name, specialty or department and view available time slots.
user_stories: As a patient, I can search doctors by specialty so that I can find the right care provider.
As a doctor, I can set my weekly availability so that patients only book times I can attend.
acceptance_criteria: Given a specialty filter, When the patient searches, Then only matching doctors with open slots are listed.
Given a doctor updates availability, When a patient views the calendar, Then the new slots are shown within 1 minute.

features.name: Appointment Booking and Management
features.description: Patients book, reschedule and cancel appointments, with conflicts prevented automatically.
user_stories: As a patient, I can book an available slot with a doctor so that I secure a visit time.
As a patient, I can reschedule or cancel an appointment so that I can adapt to changes in my plans.
acceptance_criteria: Given an open slot, When a patient confirms the booking, Then the slot is reserved and no other patient can book it.
Given an upcoming appointment, When the patient cancels at least 24 hours ahead, Then the slot is released and a confirmation is sent.

features.name: Notifications and Reminders
features.description: The system sends email and SMS confirmations and reminders for upcoming appointments.
user_stories: As a patient, I can receive a reminder before my visit so that I do not miss my appointment.
As a receptionist, I can see reminder delivery status so that I can follow up on failed notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Given a confirmed appointment, When it is 24 hours away, Then a reminder is sent to the patient by email or SMS.
Given a booking, reschedule or cancellation, When it is saved, Then the patient receives a notification within 1 minute.

features.name: Admin and Staff Management
features.description: Administrators manage doctors, departments, schedules and view appointment reports.
user_stories: As an administrator, I can add and deactivate doctor profiles so that listings stay accurate.
As a receptionist, I can book appointments on behalf of patients so that walk-in and phone requests are handled.
acceptance_criteria: Given an admin is logged in, When they create a doctor profile, Then the doctor appears in patient search results.
Given a receptionist is logged in, When they book for a patient, Then the appointment appears in that patient's account.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Pages load in under 2 seconds and booking requests complete in under 3 seconds at 200 concurrent users.
All data is encrypted with TLS 1.2+ in transit and AES-256 at rest; passwords are hashed with bcrypt.
The system maintains 99.9% monthly uptime, excluding scheduled maintenance windows.
Patient data handling complies with HIPAA/GDPR, with audit logs of all access to patient records retained for 6 years.
A patient can complete a booking in under 2 minutes and the UI meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility.
